item.title: FutureNet Asia 2026: Shaping the Future of Connectivity with AI and Automation Host operators: Axiata, Singtel and Telenor Asia
item.summary: As the telecommunications industry accelerates toward AI-native operations, autonomous networks, and intelligent service delivery, FutureNet Asia returns to Singapore on 22–23 September as one of the region’s premier gatherings for telecom leaders driving the next generation of network transformation.
